title: coap_config test app cannot build on the 4.1.0 workspace: zcbor module stub lacks headers (zcbor_decode.h missing)
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-wmae (strnlen replacement) on heft: west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/tests/coap_config fails with coap_config.c:18 fatal error: zcbor_decode.h: No such file or directory - the zcbor module dir (lichen-workspace/zephyr/modules/zcbor) contains no headers on the 4.1.0 workspace (the module stub predates/parallels the zcbor Kconfig-loop issue in the 4.1.0 workspace memory note and t370's pinned-tree cluster). The tests/coap_config/src/main.c also includes zcbor_decode.h directly. Consequence: the app's -Werror gate (including wmae's strnlen->memchr change in subsys/lichen/coap/coap_config.c) is unverifiable on heft for THIS app; coap_rangetest and coap_waypoints apps DO build clean with the same pattern (verified). Fix options: point the workspace's zcbor module at a real zcbor checkout (west update with a working revision, or the pinned v3.7.0 tree where it works), or vendor zcbor headers. Until then coap_config.c compiles unverified on heft - its edit mirrors the reviewed af780aefe1 pattern exactly (same memchr helper as coap_status.c).
